warning: Red outlines are CT DEEP’s own closure areas (Connecticut Hunting Areas Map) and the 2026–27 guide’s local closures; areas closed to all hunting are DEEP state-land closures. Amber marks places open with conditions. Not being listed does NOT make a place open — the 500-foot (250-foot on tidal water) building rule applies everywhere. Federal refuges have their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: CT DEEP Areas Closed to Hunting; 2026–2027 Connecticut Migratory Bird Hunting Guide, Local Regulations.

areas.d: Niantic River (Waterford / East Lyme): no hunting from the shore or the intertidal area without the riparian owner’s permission, and from boats only along the midline of the river. The closed water north of Sandy Point and Smith Cove is red. Rule 2. NHD has no water surface named for the river, so the circle is an approximate locator at its USGS place name.

areas.n: Great Island (Old Lyme) — temporary blinds only
areas.d: All waterfowl hunting on the state-controlled land and water here is from temporary blinds only (a cripple may be shot within the open area). No permanent blinds or structures on any state-controlled land or water. Rule 6 (state regulations). The circle is an approximate locator at the USGS place name.

areas.n: Ragged Rock Creek WMA — temporary blinds only
areas.d: All waterfowl hunting on the state-controlled land and water here is from temporary blinds only (a cripple may be shot within the open area). No permanent blinds or structures on any state-controlled land or water. Rule 6 (state regulations). Outline: DEEP’s Ragged Rock Creek WMA; its closed part is red.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: Alewife Cove and its entrance channel (Waterford / New London), and Jordan Cove north of the mean high water line on the north side of the sand spit and island. Rule 3.

No waterfowl hunting in or from the banks of Ash Creek north of the line from the north end of the steel railing on the Fairfield fishing pier to the north end of the stone sea wall in Bridgeport, at the creek mouth. Rule 14.

Greenwich: no waterfowl hunting in Greenwich Cove north of the Willowmere Point line; in Cos Cob Harbor north of the line due east from the power-plant point; in Greenwich Harbor, Smith Cove and Indian Harbor north of the Round Island – Indian Field Road line; or in Byram Harbor north of the Dock Road – Gamecock Island line. Rule 17.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: the shores and waters of the Branford River from Route 1 south to Montowese Avenue. Rule 18.

New for 2026–27. Closed to waterfowl hunting: the Black Hall River (Old Lyme) upstream from Route 156 to the first upstream railroad crossing, and upstream from the second tidal creek north of the Amtrak line to Mile Creek Road. The stretch between stays open. Posted on site. Rule 9.

Greenwich: no waterfowl hunting in Greenwich Cove north of the Willowmere Point line; in Cos Cob Harbor north of the line due east from the power-plant point; in Greenwich Harbor, Smith Cove and Indian Harbor north of the Round Island – Indian Field Road line; or in Byram Harbor north of the Dock Road – Gamecock Island line. Rule 17.

Westport: no waterfowl hunting from the shores and waters shoreward of lines from the tip of Cedar Point to the southerly tip of the stone breakwall at the east end of Compo Beach, and to the southwest tip of Hendrick’s Point. Rule 4.

Greenwich: no waterfowl hunting in Greenwich Cove north of the Willowmere Point line; in Cos Cob Harbor north of the line due east from the power-plant point; in Greenwich Harbor, Smith Cove and Indian Harbor north of the Round Island – Indian Field Road line; or in Byram Harbor north of the Dock Road – Gamecock Island line. Rule 17.

Greenwich: no waterfowl hunting in Greenwich Cove north of the Willowmere Point line; in Cos Cob Harbor north of the line due east from the power-plant point; in Greenwich Harbor, Smith Cove and Indian Harbor north of the Round Island – Indian Field Road line; or in Byram Harbor north of the Dock Road – Gamecock Island line. Rule 17.

No waterfowl hunting in Cove Pond (Holly Pond), Stamford and Darien, north of the dam; and none in the tidal waters of Cove Harbor within 100 feet of the mean high tide mark of the Darien shore. Rules 5 and 6.

Closed to waterfowl hunting: the shores and waters of the Housatonic River (Stratford / Milford) south from the I-95 bridge to an east–west line across the river through the north tip of the island off the end of Riverview Place. Rule 23.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: Alewife Cove and its entrance channel (Waterford / New London), and Jordan Cove north of the mean high water line on the north side of the sand spit and island. Rule 3.

Thames River, Waterford: no waterfowl hunting in Smith Cove northwest of and above the railroad tracks, or in Mamacoke Cove west of a line due north from the easternmost point at Harrison’s Landing to the southern tip of Mamacoke Island, including the unnamed cove and waterbody west of the tracks. Rule 15.

No waterfowl hunting in any direction within 500 feet of the mean high tide mark at Merwin Point (Milford), or in the area between the shoreline and a line from the southern edge of that radius west to the southeastern shore at Pond Point. Rule 11.
No hunting in Gulf Pond (Milford) between the Milford breakwater and the Metro-North tracks, or in Milford Harbor from the breakwater north to the Memorial Bridge. Rule 21.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: the Mystic River from Route 27 south to Route 1 (Mystic / Groton). Rule 13.

Niantic River (Waterford / East Lyme): no hunting in the water north of an east–west line touching the southern tip of Sandy Point (Kenny Cove included), and none in Smith Cove and its entrance channel (East Lyme). Rule 2, 2026–27 guide.

Giant’s Neck, East Lyme: no waterfowl hunting from the shore and water at the mouth of the Pataguanset River north of a line due west from the south end of the fixed pier at the Giant’s Neck Boat Association launch to the south end of the breakwall at the end of Point Road. Rule 16.
Plum Bank WMA (Old Saybrook): no waterfowl hunting north and east of a line from Southview Circle southeast to Gull Lane. Rule 20.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: Poquetanuck Cove (Preston / Ledyard). Rule 7.
Closed to waterfowl hunting: Post Cove (Deep River), south of the dike across the north edge of the cove. Rule 19.

Closed to waterfowl hunting: Ram Point Cove on Mason’s Island, inland of a line from the high water mark at the southernmost tip of Ram Point to the southernmost tip of Mason’s Island on the east side of the cove. Rule 8.

Niantic River (Waterford / East Lyme): no hunting in the water north of an east–west line touching the southern tip of Sandy Point (Kenny Cove included), and none in Smith Cove and its entrance channel (East Lyme). Rule 2, 2026–27 guide.

Thames River, Waterford: no waterfowl hunting in Smith Cove northwest of and above the railroad tracks, or in Mamacoke Cove west of a line due north from the easternmost point at Harrison’s Landing to the southern tip of Mamacoke Island, including the unnamed cove and waterbody west of the tracks. Rule 15.
